DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。住所のお手続きについて、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your address-related procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の市から室蘭市へ引っ越して来ました。転入の手続きの窓口へ行きたいんですが、持っている書類で足りるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別の市から転入したいと伝え、担当窓口と持参書類を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved to Muroran from another city. I'd like to go to the counter for registering my move here, but I'm worried I may not have enough documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have moved from another city and ask about the appropriate counter and the documents you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前のお住まいの自治体での手続きについて、何か書類や案内を受け取っていますか。まず書類の名前を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received any documents or instructions about the procedures at your previous municipality? Let's check the document names first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙が転出の書類だと思っていました。でも上には引越会社の名前が書いてあって、自治体の書類ではなさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転出書類だと思った紙には引越会社の名があり、自治体の書類ではなさそうだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought this paper was a moving-out document. But it has the moving company's name at the top, so it doesn't seem to be a municipal document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the paper you thought was a moving-out document has the moving company's name and does not seem to be from the municipality. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 引越会社の伝票と住所の届出は別のものですね。前の自治体で行った手続きと、受け取った案内を担当者へ伝えて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: A moving company's slip and notification of your address are separate things. Let's explain to the person in charge what you did at your previous municipality and what instructions you received, and check with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の自治体へ住所変更の相談はしましたが、手続きが終わったかはわかりません。携帯に案内メールがあるので見せてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前の自治体に相談したが手続きの完了は不明だと伝え、案内メールを見せてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked my previous municipality about changing my address, but I don't know whether the procedure was completed. I have an email with instructions on my phone. May I show it to you?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you consulted your previous municipality but do not know whether the procedure was completed, and ask to show the instruction email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。メールの内容と本人確認に使える書類を確認します。状況によって必要なものが違うので、完了したと決めつけず相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll check the email and the documents you can use for identification. What's needed depends on your circumstances, so please ask rather than assume the procedure is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードはあります。足りないものがあれば、前の自治体へ何と問い合わせればいいかも、担当窓口で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードがあると答え、不足があれば前の自治体へ何を問い合わせるか担当に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card. If anything is missing, I'd also like to ask the appropriate counter what I should ask my previous municipality.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have your residence card and want to ask the person in charge what to inquire about at your previous municipality if anything is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な書類名と問い合わせる内容を具体的に確認するとよいですね。こちらでの受付方法も含めて、担当者が順に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's a good idea to check the specific document names and what to ask. The person in charge will explain each step, including how to register here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 引越会社の紙と自治体の案内を分け、在留カードとメールを見せます。未確認の手続きと必要書類を整理してから、前の自治体へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 引越会社の紙と自治体の案内を分け、在留カードとメールを見せて必要書類を整理してから問い合わせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separate the moving company's paper from the municipal instructions and show my residence card and the email. I'll organize the unconfirmed procedures and required documents before contacting my previous municipality.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the moving company's paper from the municipal instructions, show your residence card and email, and organize the required documents before making inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。転入の担当窓口へご案内します。わからない書類名は、その場でメモしてご確認ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the counter handling move-in registration. Please write down any document names you don't understand and check them there. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付について、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there something you need help with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。熱とのどの痛みがあるので診てもらいたいんですが、先に初診の紙を書けばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めて来院し熱とのどの痛みで受診したいと伝え、先に初診の書類を書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. I have a fever and a sore throat and would like to see a doctor. Should I fill in the first-visit form first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that this is your first visit and you want to be seen for a fever and sore throat, and ask whether to fill in the first-visit paperwork first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の前に症状を担当者へ伝えます。予約はされていますか。症状はいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before the paperwork, I'll tell the person in charge about your symptoms. Do you have an appointment? When did the symptoms start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜からです。予約したつもりですが、画面を見ると室蘭のこちらではなく、前に住んでいた所の病院名が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状は昨夜からと答え、予約画面が以前住んでいた地域の別の病院だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last night. I thought I made an appointment, but when I check the screen, it shows the name of the hospital where I used to live, rather than this one in Muroran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the symptoms started last night and explain that the appointment screen was for a different hospital in your previous area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの予約かは確認が必要ですね。受診できるかと案内場所を担当者へ確認します。ほかに今つらい症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll need to check whether the appointment is for here. I'll ask the person in charge whether you can be seen and where you should go. Are there any other symptoms troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩いて来てかなりだるくなりました。待てるかどうかも自分ではわかりません。座る場所を案内して、医療スタッフに知らせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩いてだるさが強くなり待てるか分からないと伝え、座る場所の案内と医療スタッフへの連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've become very weak after walking here. I don't know whether I'm well enough to wait. Could you show me somewhere to sit and let the medical staff know?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that walking has made you feel much weaker and you do not know whether you can wait; ask for somewhere to sit and for the medical staff to be notified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、医療スタッフへ症状を伝えます。待機場所は案内に従ってください。本人確認などに使える書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll tell the medical staff about your symptoms. Please follow the directions about where to wait. Have you brought documents that can be used for identification and similar purposes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: マイナンバーカードと在留カードがあります。前の病院の予約は別のものだと、受付でもはっきり伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参したマイナンバーカードと在留カードを伝え、予約は別の病院のものだとはっきり説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my My Number card and residence card. I'll also clearly tell reception that the appointment is for a different hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Name the My Number card and residence card you brought and say you will clearly explain that your appointment is for another hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類の確認と受診の案内は担当者が行います。待っている間に症状が変わったら、すぐ職員へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check your documents and explain how you can be seen. If your symptoms change while you're waiting, tell a staff member immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜からの熱とのどの痛み、今のだるさを先に伝えます。別の病院の予約画面と書類を見せ、ここでの受付方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨夜からの症状と今のだるさを先に伝え、別病院の予約画面と書類を示して受付方法を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first explain the fever and sore throat since last night and my current weakness. I'll show the appointment screen for the other hospital and my documents, then check how to register here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first explain the symptoms since last night and your current weakness, show the other hospital's appointment screen and your documents, and check the registration procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。医療スタッフにおつなぎしますので、案内した場所でお待ちください。つらくなった時は遠慮なくお知らせください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll put you in touch with medical staff, so please wait in the place we've shown you. Don't hesitate to tell us if you feel worse. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 室蘭で買い物した後、財布がないことに気づきました。スーパーで払った時にあったと思うので、紛失の届け出をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買い物後に財布がないと気づいたと伝え、店での支払い時にはあったと思うので紛失の届出を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: After shopping in Muroran, I realized my wallet was missing. I think I had it when I paid at the supermarket, so I'd like to report it lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed your wallet missing after shopping and ask about reporting it lost, as you think you had it when paying at the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に財布を使った場面を確認しましょう。スーパーでは、財布から現金やカードを出して支払いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the last time you used your wallet. At the supermarket, did you pay with cash or a card taken from it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確認したら携帯で払っていました。財布を見たのは朝、駅へ行く前に飲み物を買った時です。最後の場所を思い違いしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スーパーでは携帯で払っていたと訂正し、財布を最後に見たのは朝の飲み物購入時だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: After checking, I see I paid with my phone. The last time I saw my wallet was when I bought a drink in the morning before going to the station. I misremembered the last place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself that you paid by phone at the supermarket, and explain that you last saw the wallet when buying a drink in the morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、朝に財布を確認した場所と、その後の移動を記録しましょう。財布の特徴と、中に入っていたものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's record where you confirmed you had the wallet in the morning and where you went afterward. Please describe the wallet and what was inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 茶色で、角に傷があります。銀行のカードも入っていました。在留カードは家に置いているはずですが、それもなくしたと言わない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布の色と傷、銀行カードが入っていたことを伝え、在留カードは自宅かもしれないので紛失と断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's brown and has a scratch on one corner. There was also a bank card inside. My residence card should be at home, so I shouldn't say I lost that as well, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the wallet's color and scratch and the bank card inside, and say you will not assume the residence card is lost because it may be at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確かに入っていたものと、まだ確認していないものを分けて伝えてください。銀行のカードの扱いは、発行元にも早めに相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish the things you know were inside from those you haven't checked yet. For the bank card, please also contact its issuer promptly about what to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行へも連絡します。財布が見つかった時に携帯へ連絡してほしいんですが、仕事中に出られない場合の確認方法も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行にも相談すると伝え、仕事中に連絡へ出られない場合の確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll contact the bank, too. I'd like you to call my mobile if the wallet is found, but I also want to know how to check if I can't answer while working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also consult the bank, and ask how to check if you cannot answer a call at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡先と、電話に出にくい時間を受付で確認します。問い合わせる時に必要な受付情報も、手続きの際にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: At reception, we'll check your contact details and the times when it's difficult for you to answer. During the procedure, we'll also explain the reference information you'll need when making inquiries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 朝の店からの経路を伝え、入っていたと確認できるカードだけ記録してもらいます。連絡できる時間も伝え、銀行には別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 朝の店からの経路と確実に入っていたカード、連絡できる時間を伝え、銀行には別に相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain my route from the morning shop and have only the cards I'm certain were inside recorded. I'll also give the times I can be contacted and consult the bank separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your route from the morning shop, the cards definitely inside, and the times you can be contacted, and say you will consult the bank separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず朝に財布を使った場所を確認しましょう。後で思い出した情報も追加でお知らせください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's first check where you used the wallet in the morning. Please also tell us any information you remember later. Thank you for coming to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送について確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you'd like to check about sending a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の友人へこの箱を送りたいです。室蘭の郵便局を初めて使うので、宛名と送り方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内の友人へ箱を送りたいと伝え、宛名と送り方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send this box to a friend within Japan. This is my first time using a post office in Muroran, so please explain how to address and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send a box to a friend within Japan and ask how to address and send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先と内容物を確認します。箱には何が入っていますか。壊れやすいものや、電池を使うものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the destination and contents. What's inside the box? Are there any fragile items or anything that uses a battery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 服と携帯用の充電器があります。箱を閉じたので中身は説明しなくていいと思っていましたが、電池の確認も必要なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服と携帯用充電器が入っていると説明し、封をしていても中身と電池の確認が必要だと理解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are clothes and a portable charger. Since I'd sealed the box, I thought I didn't need to explain the contents, but the battery needs checking too, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the box contains clothes and a portable charger, and acknowledge that the contents and battery need checking even if it is sealed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容物を具体的に伝えてください。電池の種類や梱包によって確認が必要なので、担当者が発送方法と受け付けを確認します。商品の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the contents specifically. Checks are needed depending on the battery type and packaging, so the person in charge will confirm the shipping method and whether we can accept it. Do you have product information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 型番の写真があります。箱の中で服に包んだだけなので、電池部分や端子の扱いも見てもらってから封を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 型番の写真を示し、服で包んだだけなので電池や端子の扱いを確認してから封を直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photo of the model number. I've only wrapped it in clothes inside the box, so I'd like someone to check how the battery section and terminals should be handled before I reseal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the model-number photo and say it is only wrapped in clothes, so you want to check the battery and terminals before resealing the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 情報を見せていただき、確認できる梱包方法を担当者へ相談しましょう。ここで受け付けられるかは、確認が済むまで確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's show the information and ask the person in charge about a packaging method we can verify. We can't confirm whether we can accept it here until those checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できない場合は、充電器を抜いて服だけ送ることも考えます。箱を開ける時は、作業してよい場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認できなければ充電器を抜いて服だけ送る案も伝え、箱を開けてよい作業場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it can't be verified, I'll also consider taking out the charger and sending just the clothes. Please tell me where I can work when opening the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest removing the charger and sending only the clothes if it cannot be verified, and ask for a place where you may open the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作業場所を案内します。内容物が変わったら申告内容も直し、箱の大きさと重さで利用できる方法を改めて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you a place to work. If the contents change, please correct your declaration, and we'll check the available methods again based on the box's size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 型番と中身を見せ、受け付けと梱包を確認してから封をします。充電器を抜く場合は申告を直し、宛名と料金を確かめて差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 型番と内容を示して受付可否と梱包を確認し、中身を変えたら申告も直して宛名と料金を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the model number and contents, confirm acceptance and packaging, then seal the box. If I remove the charger, I'll correct the declaration, check the address and fee, then hand it over for sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the model number and contents, check acceptance and packaging, correct the declaration if the contents change, and check the address and fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず商品の写真と送り先を確認します。中身に合う案内をしますので、そのままお待ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll first check the product photo and destination. Please wait while we provide guidance appropriate to the contents. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。申込書の記入で、どの欄を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Which section of the application form would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の申込書に氏と名の欄があります。職場ではアナと呼ばれていて、勤務先の紙もその名前だけです。ここにもアナと書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座申込書の氏と名の欄に、勤務先で使う短い呼び名のアナを書いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bank account application has surname and given-name fields. At work, I'm called Ana, and the paperwork from my employer only has that name. May I write Ana here, too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put the shortened name Ana used at work in the surname and given-name fields of the account application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この申込書は、本人確認資料にある氏と名の区分をそれぞれ写す案内です。お持ちの資料では、二つの欄にどう書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this form, you're asked to copy the surname and given names separately as shown on your identification. How are they written in the two fields of the document you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 資料の氏の欄はSILVA COSTA、名の欄はANA MARIAです。職場のアナは短い呼び方なので、資料の名前全部とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認資料の氏はSILVA COSTA、名はANA MARIAで、職場のアナは省略した呼び名だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The surname field on my document says SILVA COSTA, and the given-name field says ANA MARIA. Ana at work is a shortened name, so it's different from my full name on the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your identification shows SILVA COSTA as your surname and ANA MARIA as your given names, and that Ana at work is shortened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この申込書では、その区分どおりに、氏の欄へSILVA COSTA、名の欄へANA MARIAを記入します。ご自身で名前の区切りを変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. On this form, follow that division: write SILVA COSTA in the surname field and ANA MARIA in the given-name field. Please don't change the division of your name yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 氏はSILVAだけかと思いました。COSTAを真ん中の名前と考えて省きかけましたが、資料では二つとも氏の欄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: COSTAを別の名前と考えて省きかけたが、資料ではSILVAとCOSTAの両方が氏の欄にあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought my surname was just SILVA. I almost left out COSTA, thinking it was a middle name, but the document has both in the surname field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you almost omitted COSTA because you thought it was a different name, but the document puts both SILVA and COSTA in the surname field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その資料ではSILVA COSTAが氏として示されています。COSTAを落としたり、名の欄へ移したりせず、記入後に資料と一つずつ照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That document shows SILVA COSTA as your surname. Don't leave COSTA out or move it to the given-name field. After completing the form, let's compare each part with the document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 氏はSILVA COSTA、名はANA MARIAと記入しました。略したアナではなく、二つの欄を資料と比べて確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏へSILVA COSTA、名へANA MARIAを記入し、略称ではなく資料の区分と一致しているか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written SILVA COSTA as my surname and ANA MARIA as my given names. Could you check the two fields against the document, rather than the shortened name Ana?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have entered SILVA COSTA as your surname and ANA MARIA as your given names, and ask to check they match the document's division rather than a shortened name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの二つの欄は、資料の区分と一致しています。勤務先へ給与口座を伝える時も、職場での呼び名と口座に登録された表記を混ぜないよう、提出する情報を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: These two fields match the division on your document. When giving your employer your salary account details, too, please check the information you submit so you don't mix your workplace nickname with the name registered on your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 申込書は資料の氏と名を省略せずに写します。勤務先への提出にも呼び名だけを使わず、口座の登録表記を確認してから伝えます。ほかの欄も案内を見て記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料の氏名を省略せずに記入し、勤務先にも呼び名だけではなく確認した口座登録表記を伝え、残りの欄も案内を見て記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll copy the surname and given names from my identification without abbreviating them. When submitting information to my employer, I won't use just my nickname; I'll check the registered account name before passing it on. I'll complete the other fields by following the instructions, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will enter your full surname and given names from the document, give your employer the verified registered account name rather than just your nickname, and follow the instructions for the remaining fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。氏名の記入を確認できました。続いてほかの記入事項と申込条件を確認します。記入ができたことだけで口座開設が決まったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We've checked your name entry. Next, we'll check the other information and application conditions. Completing the form alone does not mean the account has been approved for opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お探しの商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there a particular product you're looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 豆腐を探しています。室蘭のこのスーパーは初めてで、いつも買う商品の写真を見せれば売り場を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 豆腐を探していると伝え、普段の商品の写真を見せて売場を案内してもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for tofu. This is my first time at this supermarket in Muroran. If I show you a photo of the product I usually buy, could you tell me where to find it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for tofu and ask whether you can show a photo of your usual product to be directed to its section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を見せてください。同じ商品があるかは売場で確認します。料理に使う予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the photo. We'll check in the section whether we have the same product. Are you planning to use it for cooking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今夜、炒める料理に使います。同じ商品がなければ代わりでもいいですが、やわらかさの違いは確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今夜炒める料理に使うと答え、同じ商品がなければ代わりでもよいが固さを確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm using it in a stir-fried dish tonight. If you don't have the same product, an alternative is fine, but I'd like to check how the softness differs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will use it in a stir-fried dish tonight and an alternative is fine if the same product is unavailable, but you want to check the firmness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用途に合わせて表示を比べましょう。まず冷蔵売場の候補を確認します。代わりの商品でも、保存方法はそれぞれ見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the labels for your intended use. First, we'll check the options in the refrigerated section. Even for alternatives, please check each product's storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前に箱入りで常温の棚にあったものも豆腐だと思います。豆腐なら全部同じ場所にあって、同じように置けると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前常温の棚で箱入り商品を見たと伝え、豆腐ならどれも同じ置場と保存方法だと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think something I saw before in a carton on a room-temperature shelf was tofu, too. I thought all tofu would be kept in the same place and could be stored the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention seeing a boxed product on a room-temperature shelf before and explain that you thought all tofu shared the same location and storage method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装や保存条件が違う商品もあります。豆腐という名前だけで保存方法を決めず、今選ぶ商品の表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Some products have different packaging and storage conditions. Don't decide how to store it just from the name tofu; check the label of the product you choose now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今日の候補で炒めやすさと保存表示を見ます。写真の商品がない場合、入荷予定がわかるかも聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今の候補の固さと保存表示を確認すると伝え、いつもの商品がなければ入荷予定も聞いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll check how suitable today's options are for stir-frying and read their storage labels. If the product in the photo isn't available, could you also ask whether its next delivery date is known?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the current options' firmness and storage labels, and ask about the next delivery if your usual product is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲で調べますが、予定がわからない場合もあります。今日は代わりを選ぶか、ほかの食材に変えるかをご判断ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check what we can, but the delivery schedule may not be known. Please decide whether to choose an alternative today or use a different ingredient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず売場で候補を比べ、条件が合えば代わりを買います。入荷予定が不明なら待つと決めず、保存表示を確認して今夜の料理を考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補の条件が合えば代わりを買い、入荷予定が不明なら待つと決めず今夜の料理を考え直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first compare the options in the section and buy an alternative if it meets my needs. If the delivery schedule is unknown, I won't simply decide to wait; I'll check the storage label and rethink tonight's meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy an alternative if it meets your needs, and if the delivery schedule is unknown, rethink tonight's meal rather than decide to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真を見ながら売場へご案内します。選ぶ商品の表示で確認していきましょう。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the section while looking at the photo. Let's check the label on whichever product you choose. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園内で、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there something you need help with in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 室蘭の公園で少し休みたいです。近くのベンチがぬれていたので、座れる別の場所と利用のルールを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れたベンチの代わりに休める場所を探していると伝え、公園の利用ルールも尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take a short break in this park in Muroran. The nearby bench was wet, so I'd like to know another place to sit and the rules for using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are looking for somewhere to rest instead of the wet bench, and ask about the park rules. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図で休憩場所を確認しましょう。今はどの辺りにいらっしゃいましたか。候補として考えている場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the rest areas on the map. Where were you just now? Is there somewhere you're considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の近くです。花壇の縁が乾いていたので座れると思いましたが、花のそばに入っていいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口近くの花壇の縁が乾いていたと説明し、そこへ入って座ってよいか分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near the entrance. The edge of the flower bed was dry, so I thought I could sit there, but I don't know whether it's okay to go close to the flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the edge of the flower bed near the entrance was dry, and say you do not know whether you may enter that area and sit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇内へ入らず、休憩に使える場所を確認してください。通路の縁でも、人が通る場所を塞がないようにしましょう。飲食もされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't enter the flower bed; check which places can be used for resting. Even at the edge of the path, make sure not to block where people walk. Will you also be eating or drinking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲み物と小さなおにぎりがあります。ごみ箱が見当たらないので、食べてよい場所かと、ごみをどうするかを先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲み物とおにぎりがあるがごみ箱は見えないと伝え、飲食してよい場所とごみの扱いを先に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a drink and a small rice ball. I can't see any bins, so I'd like to first check where I may eat and what to do with my rubbish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a drink and rice ball but cannot see any bins, and want to first check where eating and drinking are allowed and how to deal with rubbish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この入口の掲示では、案内板右側の休憩スペースで飲食できます。ごみ箱は置いていないので、ごみは持ち帰る案内です。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The notice at this entrance says you can eat and drink in the rest area to the right of the information board. There are no bins, so visitors are asked to take their rubbish home. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋を持っています。使えるベンチが遠ければ、入口近くで立って飲むだけにしますが、邪魔にならない位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰り用の袋があると伝え、使えるベンチが遠ければ入口近くで立って飲むため通行の邪魔にならない場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a bag. If a usable bench is far away, I'll just stand and have my drink near the entrance, but please show me a spot where I won't be in the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a bag for taking rubbish home and ask for somewhere out of the way to stand and drink near the entrance if a usable bench is far away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の案内板の右側に、通路から外れた休憩スペースがあります。そこで立って飲めます。花壇の縁や出入口の正面ではなく、案内板右側の表示のある所を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: To the right of the entrance information board, there's a rest area off the path. You can stand and drink there. Please use that marked area to the right of the board, rather than the flower-bed edge or directly in front of the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇には入らず、案内で休憩場所と飲食の扱いを確認します。通路を塞がない所を選び、ごみは袋に入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇へ入らず休憩と飲食の案内を確認し、通路を塞がない場所を選んでごみは持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't enter the flower bed. I'll check the guidance about rest areas and eating and drinking. I'll choose somewhere that doesn't block the path and put my rubbish in a bag to take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stay out of the flower bed, check the guidance for resting and eating, choose a spot that keeps the path clear, and take your rubbish home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず入口付近の案内を見ましょう。周囲に配慮しながら、どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's first look at the guidance near the entrance. Please relax and enjoy your time while being considerate of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動について、何をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like me to look up about your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約の列車に乗り換えたいです。釧路駅で待っていれば乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約の列車に乗り換えたいと伝え、釧路駅で待てば乗れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to change to the train on this reservation. Can I board it if I wait at Kushiro Station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change to your reserved train and ask whether you can board it by waiting at Kushiro Station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約画面の出発駅と到着駅を、一緒に確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May we check the departure and arrival stations on your reservation screen together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発が別の駅で、到着が釧路になっています。画面を反対に読んでいました。ここから出発する予約を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約画面の出発駅と到着駅を逆に読んだと説明し、釧路出発の予約を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It departs from another station and arrives in Kushiro. I was reading the screen the wrong way round. I'd like to check the reservation departing from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you read the departure and arrival stations in reverse and want to check a reservation departing from Kushiro. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、別の予約がないかご確認ください。一緒に行かれる方も同じ列車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please check whether you have another reservation. Is the person you're traveling with on the same train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者が予約をまとめています。改札で待ち合わせと言われましたが、改札の内側か外側かは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者が予約をまとめていると伝え、改札の内外のどちらで待ち合わせるか未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My companion is handling the reservations together. They told me to meet at the ticket gates, but I haven't asked whether they mean inside or outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your companion is handling the reservations and explain that you have not checked whether to meet inside or outside the ticket gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗る列車が決まるまでは、入場せずに同行者へ予約と待ち合わせ場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Until you've confirmed your train, please stay outside the gates and check the reservation and meeting place with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者から正しい釧路出発の予約が届き、列車はT-6、待ち合わせは改札の外だと確認できました。この予約で乗り場を調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者から釧路出発のT-6と改札外の待合せを確認できたと伝え、その予約で乗り場を調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion has sent the correct reservation departing from Kushiro. I've confirmed that the train is T-6 and we're meeting outside the gates. Could you look up the platform using this reservation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your companion confirmed T-6 departing from Kushiro and a meeting outside the gates, and ask to look up the platform using that reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約のT-6と、この案内表示のT-6が一致しています。表示は2番のりばです。別の到着予約ではなく、今の出発予約を見ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: T-6 on your reservation matches T-6 on this information display. The display says platform 2. We're looking at your current departure reservation, not the other arrival reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: T-6が2番のりばですね。先に改札の外で同行者と合流し、二人でこの予約と当日の表示を確かめてから入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: T-6は2番のりばと復唱し、改札外で同行者と合流して二人で予約と当日の表示を確認してから入ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: T-6 is platform 2, then. I'll first meet my companion outside the gates. We'll both check this reservation and today's display before going through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that T-6 is on platform 2 and say you will meet your companion outside the gates and check the reservation and today's display together before entering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約の確認ができてよかったです。同行者と合流してからご乗車ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we could confirm the reservation. Please meet your companion before boarding. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can we help you with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先に出す住民票の写しが必要です。家族と住んでいますが、全員分を申し込むんでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先に提出する住民票の写しが必要だと伝え、同居家族全員分を申し込むのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need a copy of my resident record to submit to my employer. I live with my family. Should I apply for one covering everyone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need a copy of your resident record for your employer and ask whether to apply for all family members living with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指定を確認しましょう。勤務先からの案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check what the recipient has specified. Have you brought the instructions from your employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールに「本人分」とあります。家族の情報も必要だと思っていましたが、私だけのものを希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先のメールには本人分とあると示し、家族分ではなく自分だけのものを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The email says 'for the individual concerned.' I thought they needed my family's information too, but I'd like one for just myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the employer's email says it is for you alone, and request your own record rather than your family's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人分ですね。記載項目の指定はありますか。個人番号などは提出先の要否を確かめて選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: For you alone, then. Have they specified which details to include? Please check whether the recipient needs items such as your Individual Number before choosing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールには個人番号は不要と書かれています。本籍については書かれていないので、勝手に付けずに会社へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個人番号は不要と指定されているが本籍の指定はないと説明し、会社へ確認してから選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The email says the Individual Number isn't needed. It doesn't mention registered domicile, so I'd like to check with the company instead of adding it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the Individual Number is specified as unnecessary but registered domicile is not mentioned, and say you want to check with the company before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。不明な項目を確認してから申請できます。申請書のどの欄がわからないかお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can apply after checking the unclear items. Please tell me which fields on the form you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この「世帯主・続柄」の欄です。会社に確認する時に、その言葉も読めるようメモしていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 世帯主・続柄の欄が分からないと示し、会社への確認用に読み方も控えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This 'head of household / relationship' field. May I also note how to read those words so I can ask my company about them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out that you do not understand the head-of-household and relationship field and ask to note the pronunciation for checking with your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。「せたいぬし・つづきがら」と読みます。項目の意味と、申請時の本人確認についてもご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. It's read 'setainushi / tsuzukigara.' I'll also explain the meaning of the items and the identification required when applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人分で、個人番号は不要と整理しました。本籍と続柄の要否を会社へ聞いてから、申請書を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人分で個人番号は不要と整理し、本籍と続柄の要否を会社へ聞いてから申請書を仕上げると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've established that I need a record for myself and don't need the Individual Number. I'll finish the form after asking my company whether registered domicile and relationship details are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have established that the record is for yourself and the Individual Number is unnecessary, and will complete the form after checking whether registered domicile and relationship details are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定が確認できたら、記入した申請書をお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you've confirmed the requirements, please bring the completed application. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の予約を変更したいです。勤務が変わったので、午後の時間に移せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務の変更で来週の予約を午後へ移したいと伝え、変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to change next week's appointment. My work schedule has changed. Could I move it to the afternoon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a change in work schedule means you want to move next week's appointment to the afternoon, and ask about changing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を拝見します。こちらには検査と診察の二つが記載されていますが、両方の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at your appointment slip. It lists both a test and a consultation. Would you like to change both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つの予約だと思っていました。午前の検査に来られないので、診察も含めて組み直せるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査と診察を一つの予約だと思っていたと説明し、午前の検査に来られないので両方の調整を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was one appointment. I can't come for the morning test, so I'd like to discuss rescheduling both that and the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the test and consultation were one appointment and want to adjust both because you cannot attend the morning test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査担当と診療科で調整が必要です。来院できる曜日と時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The testing team and the clinical department will need to coordinate. Please tell me which days and times you can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水曜は一日空いています。金曜は午後だけです。検査の準備があるなら、水曜にまとめられるか聞いてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水曜は終日、金曜は午後なら来られると伝え、準備も考えて水曜にまとめられるか担当へ確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm free all day Wednesday. On Friday, only the afternoon works. If the test requires preparation, could you ask whether both can be scheduled for Wednesday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can attend all day Wednesday or Friday afternoon and ask the staff to check whether both can be arranged for Wednesday, taking preparation into account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。前回渡された準備の説明書もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass your preferences on to the team. Have you also brought the preparation instructions you were given last time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っていますが、変更後もこの食事の指示を使ってよいかがわかりません。新しい日時に合わせて説明を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の準備説明書を示し、変更後も同じ食事の指示でよいか分からないので新しい日時に合う説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have them, but I don't know whether I should still follow these food instructions after the change. I'd like an explanation appropriate to the new date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the previous preparation instructions and request guidance for the new date and time because you do not know whether the same dietary instructions still apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備の内容は検査担当に確認してください。予約が決まったら、日時と説明書の扱いを一緒に確認できるようお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the preparation details with the testing team. I'll ask for the date, time, and how to use the instructions to be confirmed together once the appointment is set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 検査と診察の両方を変更したいこと、水曜を第一希望にすることを伝えてください。準備も担当の説明で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査と診察の両方を変更し水曜を第一希望とすることを伝えてもらい、準備は担当者の説明で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell them I'd like to change both the test and consultation and that Wednesday is my first choice. I'll also check the preparation based on the team's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for your request to change both the test and consultation with Wednesday as first choice to be passed on, and say you will check preparation with the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。調整担当へおつなぎします。まだ変更は確定していませんので、担当からの案内をお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Noted. I'll put you in touch with the scheduling team. The change isn't confirmed yet, so please wait for their guidance. Take care.
